signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: AI features include fair monthly usage on Starter and higher limits on paid plans. Heavy usage can be topped up or is covered in higher tiers.
The default cap is 1,000 recipients per campaign and 1,000 recipient emails per account per UTC day across websites.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 3 reviews (3.0% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: I sent support email 5 days ago and still no answer.
lack of engagement by the support team
the in-app chat didn’t provide helpful answers to my questions.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 2.9 years old. Sold on AppSumo 2 times before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $69 vs a stated $299 regular price (77% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: We may make changes to the materials contained on our website at any time without notice.
We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms of Service at any time without prior notice.

finePrint.summary: AI features on lifetime-deal buyer plans are subject to fair monthly usage limits with higher tiers or top-ups for heavy use.

quote.text: AI features include fair monthly usage on Starter and higher limits on paid plans. Heavy usage can be topped up or is covered in higher tiers.

finePrint.summary: Newsletter sending on the shared domain is capped, so larger sends require the buyer's own SMTP provider.

quote.text: The default cap is 1,000 recipients per campaign and 1,000 recipient emails per account per UTC day across websites.

finePrint.summary: AI credits reset monthly rather than accumulating, limiting how much AI work carries over.

quote.text: AI credits refresh every calendar month. How do credits work?

finePrint.summary: Refunds are discretionary with no guaranteed refund period for a lifetime-deal buyer.

quote.text: Upon request, we may, in our sole discretion, grant a full or partial refund to the original funding payment.

finePrint.summary: Amounts paid for non-refundable services and third-party services will not be refunded.

quote.text: Grigora will not refund any amounts paid for non-refundable Paid Services, applications or Third Party Services.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can change website materials at any time without notice, affecting what a buyer was promised.

quote.text: We may make changes to the materials contained on our website at any time without notice.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can modify or replace the Terms of Service at any time without prior notice.

quote.text: We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms of Service at any time without prior notice.

finePrint.summary: Storage misuse can lead to content removal, account suspension or termination and denial of future service without refund.

quote.text: Abuse of storage, including use for non-website purposes, excessive or disproportionate usage, or circumventing these limits, may result in immediate action, including removal of content, suspension or termination of your account, and denial of future service, without refund.

finePrint.summary: Misconduct or abuse can result in account termination at the vendor's discretion.

quote.text: We reserve the right to take appropriate action, including termination of accounts, in response to such behavior.

finePrint.summary: The comparable regular subscription starts at $15 monthly or $12 monthly billed yearly after a 14-day free period.

quote.text: 14 days free, then from $15 a month, or $12 a month billed yearly. Cancel whenever you like.

trials.claim: Lifetime access to Grigora is included with the deal
trials.claimQuote: Grigora is packed with everything you need to create lightning-fast websites, blogs, directories, and newsletters—without any coding.Create content that works for you.Get lifetime access to Grigora today!
trials.reasoning: Buyers in E11 and E12 confirm purchasing a Grigora lifetime deal; the regular monthly pricing in E1 is not evidence against a deal-specific lifetime offer.

exhibits.quote: 14 days free, then from $15 a month, or $12 a month billed yearly. Cancel whenever you like.
exhibits.argument: The vendor sells access as a monthly subscription, not lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms of Service at any time without prior notice.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can change terms at any time, so lifetime access is not guaranteed.

exhibits.quote: So, I decided to try the Grigora lifetime deal a while back.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms a Grigora lifetime deal was offered and purchased.

exhibits.quote: prompting me to refund the lifetime deal as it wasn’t yet ready for my needs.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the purchase was structured as a lifetime deal.

trials.claim: Grigora is an AI-powered generator for landing pages with SEO optimization
trials.claimQuote: Grigora is an AI-powered website generator packed with everything you need to construct beautiful landing pages and optimize SEO.
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes generating pages from a business description and refining them in E13, and confirms built-in SEO optimization tools in E14.

exhibits.quote: Despite providing a clear, well-structured prompt (crafted with ChatGPT), the AI struggled to interpret the request and didn’t produce a usable layout.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the AI generator failed to produce a usable layout from a clear prompt.

exhibits.quote: AI features include fair monthly usage on Starter and higher limits on paid plans.
exhibits.argument: AI generation is capped by monthly usage limits rather than unlimited included use.

exhibits.quote: Describe your business, then refine the pages, copy and design in a visual editor.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes generating and refining pages from a business description.

exhibits.quote: Grigora provides built-in SEO features and tools to optimize your website for better search engine ranking.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms built-in SEO tools to optimize ranking.

trials.claim: Builder lets you create websites, publish blogs and add custom pages in minutes without coding
trials.claimQuote: Launch your website in minutesGrigora’s speed-optimized website builder lets you create ultra-fast websites, publish blogs, and add custom pages in minutes without coding a thing.
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report the preview crashed with an application error and that preview only partly works, materially undercutting fast, reliable creation and publishing in minutes.

exhibits.quote: preview crashed with an “Unexpected Application Error” (“can’t access property ‘children’, t is undefined”) and showed a JS stack trace.
exhibits.argument: Basic editing and preview crashed, undermining the claim of fast reliable creation in minutes.

exhibits.quote: Preview kinda works, but you still need to publish to see how the page really works.
exhibits.argument: The builder preview does not work reliably, contradicting easy fast publishing.

exhibits.quote: I was able to reliably build various features needed for website creation without writing any code.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms building websites without writing code.

exhibits.quote: Write posts, organise collections and publish content that fits your site.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms writing posts and publishing content capability.

trials.claim: Drag-and-drop elements and responsive layouts using pre-built customizable templates
trials.claimQuote: Drag and drop website elements like text, images, buttons, layout blocks, and moreCreate responsive, modern layouts using pre-built templates that are easy to customize
trials.reasoning: Two buyers describe the builder as very clunky and not quite drag-and-drop, outweighing the single positive drag-and-drop review.

exhibits.quote: compared to Wix, Squarespace or other web builders the drag and drop builder is very clunky.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the drag and drop builder is very clunky, not intuitive.

exhibits.quote: I'm not sure it's quite what I'd call drag/drop, but it's close.
exhibits.argument: The buyer disputes that the builder is truly drag and drop.

exhibits.quote: Grigora has completely changed how I create websites. The drag-and-drop feature is so intuitive,
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms an intuitive drag-and-drop website creation feature.

exhibits.quote: Start from designs that adapt to phone, tablet and desktop layouts.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms responsive designs that adapt to phone, tablet and desktop.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers can upgrade license to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased Grigora can upgrade their license to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: Buyers in E19 and E20 confirm upgrading their deal/license to a higher level; reports of separate fees for some extras do not negate that license upgrades were available.

exhibits.quote: Following the end of the Appsumo deal subscriptions added to access additional features even if the maximum tier has been purchased.
exhibits.argument: Buyers report needing extra subscriptions for features even at max tier instead of a license upgrade.

exhibits.quote: Only after one purchases the tool is it revealed that MCP is not included and can be purchased for an additional fee.
exhibits.argument: Key functionality requires a separate additional fee rather than a license upgrade to increase limits.

exhibits.quote: I actually upgraded my deal to the max when I could.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms upgrading their deal to a higher tier.

exhibits.quote: I am upgrading my license today while it is still available.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms upgrading their license is possible.
